title: Verified Invention Evolution Network - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: Maintains a chain of evidence showing which inventions work, under which conditions, and how successive versions improve.
body:
Verified Invention Evolution Network. Maintains a chain of evidence showing which inventions work, under which conditions, and how successive versions improve.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 20 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Universal Technology Creation". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Evidence chains are real (clinical trials, version histories); invention-wide networks are emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Verified Invention Evolution Network - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Maintains a chain of evidence showing which inventions work, under which conditions, and how successive versions improve.
body:
Known science foundations of Verified Invention Evolution Network.

Clinical trials chain evidence. Software version histories track improvement. Patent citations map lineages. A network maintaining evidence chains for inventions generally — what works, where, how versions improve — is the frontier.

Key quantity check (Inventions with evidence chains / inventions per year): computed ratio 0.00333333 against the reference value, relative error 0.001001, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Verified Invention Evolution Network - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Maintains a chain of evidence showing which inventions work, under which conditions, and how successive versions improve.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Verified Invention Evolution Network.

Evidence is fragmented. Conditions are hard to specify. Negative results are missing.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 5.48 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is per year vs versions tracked at 5.48 orders of magnitude (per year larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

1. Version control (maturity 5/5, cost 1/5, risk 1/5; score 2).

2. Trial registries (maturity 4/5, cost 1/5, risk 1/5; score 1.5).

3. Evidence synthesis (maturity 3/5, cost 2/5, risk 2/5; score 0.5).

body:
Unresolved problems for Verified Invention Evolution Network, in priority order (research burden index 22, 2 blocking):

Condition specification (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Negative results (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Fragmentation (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.

body:
What would count as evidence of success for Verified Invention Evolution Network:

Chains 1,000 inventions with evidence (weight 0.4; not yet satisfied).

Predicts version improvement (weight 0.35; not yet satisfied).

Adopted by inventors (weight 0.25; SATISFIED).

Evidence confidence: 0.25 (1 of 3 criteria satisfied). Verdict: weak. Confidence here measures satisfied evidence, not belief.
